mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_instance (app_name, app_host, agent_version, status, last_report_time) VALUES (#{appName}, #{appHost}, #{agentVersion}, 1, #{lastReportTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE app_host = VALUES(app_host), agent_version = VALUES(agent_version), status = 1, last_report_time = VALUES(last_report_time)
mapper.select: SELECT id, app_name, app_host, agent_version, status, last_report_time, create_time FROM app_instance ORDER BY status DESC, last_report_time DESC
SELECT id, app_name, app_host, agent_version, status, last_report_time, create_time FROM app_instance WHERE app_name = #{appName} LIMIT 1
